checkpointRule: Return every five completed families, or every two hours, whichever comes first. This lane carries one family, so it checkpoints once.

checkpoints.note: Both Maryland forms bound by exact SHA-256, censused field for field against the pinned binaries — 56 and 57 widgets, no unmapped widget and no stale dictionary entry — and rendered in canonical and boundary fixtures with every page rastered. Sixteen participant facts written and read back from the finalized bytes at their measured rectangles. Seven of the nine counters are zero. The two that are not are the same defect twice: MDJ-008's section 1 heading and its "Sealing or Shielding Motion" category are determined by the route and cannot be marked, because the shared AcroForm finalizer has no selection channel. Declared as the defect it is rather than relabelled an election. Not verified here.

timestampBasis: The checkpoint time is the modification time of the family's build-status.json on the build host, which is when the build that produced it finished.
